task_specification.objective: Restore a readable, larger authored cemetery arena with stable landmark visibility and collision, deliver an icon-led truthful upgrade-choice surface with clean result/retry lifecycle, and add observational dense-profile and complete-run checkpoint hooks for host recapture.

diagnosis.root_cause: The retained cemetery package is present but its shipped camera composition and product-owned spatial bindings do not preserve readable landmark silhouettes during traversal; the prior candidate-bound review specifically found the mausoleum dominating while the keeper post and cracked moon bell became unidentifiable. Dense-performance and complete-run gates also lack fresh candidate-bound runtime qualification, so this loop must repair the ordinary product surfaces and expose bounded recapture hooks without treating telemetry as proof.

stop_conditions: Do not replace, split, hide, or surgically edit the preserved authored cemetery package; stop and leave the spatial issue open if safe wrapper/binding restoration is impossible.
Do not claim dense-performance or complete-run gate closure from source checks or software-renderer samples; those require fresh candidate-bound host/Tester evidence.
Keep tester-only preparation and advance actions unavailable in release exports and do not let instrumentation alter authoritative combat or wave outcomes.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause approach from repeated transform tuning: restore one intact authored environment through explicit wrapper, collision, navigation, spawn, objective, and camera sight-lane ownership, while repairing the actual upgrade-draft presenter and adding narrowly scoped observational lifecycle/profile hooks.

code: Run focused Godot parse/import checks for the upgrade-draft presenter, run shell/controller, cemetery spatial contract, camera, dense profile, wave director, and ledger files.
Verify tester-only actions are guarded from release exports and that preserved native_godot_project and host_godot_boot baselines remain valid under host validation.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime and Tester recapture the upgrade draft at the target viewport: draft-open, keyboard focus, mouse hover/click, gamepad navigation, one debounced commit, resumed changed combat, death/result, Retry, and three fresh-run resets.

For the arena, capture spawn, critical route, near-landmark approach, departure, full perimeter, and four cardinal first-person views from an interior native street; pair with spatial bounds/collision data and shipped-camera screenshots.

Perform a real horizontal mouse-motion probe that changes yaw and camera_forward and a vertical probe that changes pitch; an unchanged digest remains an input defect. Replay ordinary movement against every side of the central landmark and along the perimeter, checking collision, disappearance/occlusion, and stable visibility.

Run serial tester dense prepare -> advance -> reset cycles on native hardware at 1920x1080 and collect renderer, preflight, sample, lifecycle, cycle-identity, and reset-isolation receipts. Exercise ordinary wave/death/result/retry checkpoints without using diagnostics as route qualification.
visual: Compare the bound Mournlight reference and fresh gameplay captures for readable keeper post, mausoleum, cracked moon bell, escape lanes, native streets, larger traversable scale, and external cemetery depth without a black or empty edge.

Inspect the full upgrade page at native, fullscreen, windowed, and supported UI scales for authored iconography, silhouettes, truthful values, restrained copy, focus hierarchy, no clipping, and no text-stacked or generic default-card presentation.

done_when: Each of the three upgrade choices leads with a recognizable authored silhouette or icon and a compact current-to-new summary with no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas.
Current values are truthful runtime values; NEW, LOCKED, UNKNOWN, or equivalent placeholders never appear in the current-value column, and unchanged or unrelated rows are omitted.
Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, pressed, unavailable, and selected states are visibly distinct without clipping or changing card dimensions.

A same-session retest can open the draft, navigate all three cards, commit one choice exactly once, verify the authoritative selected id/rank/modifier, then resume gameplay with the changed effect observable.
Result, Retry, and Return to Title transitions preserve focus, pause ownership, audio/UI reset, and fresh-run isolation across three restart attempts.
tasks.instructions: Repair the real upgrade-draft scene/controller and run-shell/result lifecycle. Implement the authored icon-led hierarchy, truthful current-to-new values, restrained copy, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus behavior in the shipped viewport. Bind the draft transaction to authoritative selection and debounced confirmation. Ensure death/victory result presentation, Retry, and Title return dispose or reset actors, timers, signals, pause reasons, audio, and UI state. Add only candidate-owned state receipts needed for Tester to inspect draft-open/focus/commit/result/retry/fresh-run states; do not substitute diagnostics for ordinary play.
tasks.title: Repair upgrade-choice hierarchy and run-shell lifecycle

done_when: The intact authored package is rebound as the sole authoritative visual environment with larger traversable scale and a coherent external world/external depth beyond the playable datum.

The keeper post, mausoleum, and cracked moon bell central building/landmark silhouettes remain readable from spawn, critical route, near approach, departure, and cardinal views; no disappearance or occlusion drift occurs during ordinary movement/movement replay.

Collision agrees with visible geometry: the player and representative enemies cannot pass through the central landmark, native streets, or the boundary/perimeter, and no invisible barrier blocks intended routes.
Spawn, objective, navigation, and perimeter anchors are derived from native authored streets/terrain; no proxy floor or generated road becomes the authoritative route surface.
The active issue finding.arena_landmarks_fully_occluded has a direct before/after retest path using shipped-camera traversal captures and white-box spatial bindings.
tasks.instructions: Restore spatial integrity around the existing cemetery scene through wrapper/binding repair rather than another camera or child-transform tweak. Expand to a larger traversable scale, retain an external world with external depth, and expose a readable central building/landmark from the shipped high-angle camera. Rebase collision, navigation, spawn, objective, and perimeter boundary to the native authored package bounds; keep the package intact and use only additive product-owned datum. Validate ordinary movement/movement replay from spawn through the critical route, all sides of the landmark, departure, and the full boundary/perimeter while checking for pass-through, disappearance, and camera occlusion.
tasks.title: Restore authored cemetery scale, landmarks, collision, and sight lanes

done_when: A deterministic candidate-owned stress hook records renderer/preflight classification, frame and physics sample distributions, active entity/projectile counts, and lifecycle deltas for each dense cycle without changing combat outcomes.

Tester-only tester_dense_prepare, tester_dense_advance, and tester_dense_reset (or equivalent existing actions) enforce prepare/advance/reset sequencing, exactly-once advancement, setup generation, cycle identity, requested/resolved/reset-isolation receipts, and a release-build guard.

A complete-run checkpoint path exposes ordinary wave progression, death/result, retry, and fresh-run isolation with generation and reset receipts while keeping diagnostic setup excluded from ordinary-route qualification.

Focused static checks show no syntax/import/runtime-log regressions in the instrumented wave, entity, and run lifecycle owners; hooks remain observational and cannot qualify a build shape or ordinary route by themselves.
tasks.instructions: Finish the candidate-side observability needed for host qualification around the authoritative dense profile, wave director, entity lifecycle, and run controller. Preserve ordinary balance and gameplay semantics. Keep prepare actions stable and inspectable without advancing or resolving state; expose separate advance/commit actions only for the transition under test; reset must return zero live actors and the next-frame input context. Record enough bounded receipts for three native 1920x1080 cycles and for complete-run retry isolation, while retaining software-renderer evidence as rejected rather than qualified.
